use default
use IO.Std.read_line
use System.Math

f(x: double) -> double => Math.sqrt(Math.abs(x)) + 5.0 * x * x * x

write_line("enter 11 numbers:")

let numbers =
    (0..11)
    |> map(_ => double.parse(read_line()!))
    |> collect_list()

numbers.reverse()

for x in numbers do
    let result = f(x)

    if result > 400.0 then
        write_line("{x}: too large")
    else
        write_line("{x}: {result}")
    fi
od

use default
use IO.Std.read_line
use System.Math

f(x: double) -> double => Math.sqrt(Math.abs(x)) + 5.0 * x * x * x

write_line("enter 11 numbers:")

let numbers =
    (0..11)
    |> map(_ => double.parse(read_line()!))
    |> collect_list()

numbers.reverse()

for x in numbers do
    let result = f(x)

    if result > 400.0 then
        write_line("{x}: too large")
    else
        write_line("{x}: {result}")
    fi
